name: featurelab
description: A node editor and live 3D preview for Minecraft Bedrock worldgen packs: browse a pack's features as a graph, edit them in forms, and see what they place.

commands.title: Feature Lab: Retry Loading the Feature Graph

featurelab.binaryPath.description: Path to the featurelab engine executable. Leave empty to use the copy bundled with this extension. Set this during development to point at a locally built cmd/featurelab binary.

featurelab.env.description: Environment preset id passed to `generate` (see featurelab/env for the available presets).

featurelab.blockTextures.description: Prepare real Minecraft block textures for the preview. The first preview offers, once, to fetch Mojang's sample resource pack (bedrock-samples, about 150 MB transferred) into your user cache directory; nothing is downloaded without that. Turning this off means nothing is ever fetched, built or asked about, and the preview's own 'Block textures' switch says so instead of sitting inert. Whether textures are actually DRAWN once an atlas exists is that switch, in the preview's sidebar, which remembers what you choose -- declining, being offline or switching either one off all leave the preview drawing flat block colours, which is what it has always drawn.

featurelab.requestTimeoutMs.description: How long the engine may go SILENT before a request is treated as stale -- not how long the request may take. The engine reports progress once a second on anything slow, and every report buys another full wait, so a big pack that needs 45 seconds to load or graph is never cut off while it is visibly working. A request that stops saying anything for this long is. For generate requests this is also a floor: the extension waits longer when the panel's Budget section raises the placement time limit above this value, and shows the raised wait there when it does.

scripts.package: npm run build:binary && npm run compile && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository --baseImagesUrl https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stirante/featurelab/HEAD/apps/vscode -o featurelab.vsix
